sources.author: Tabasco
sources.license_note: Author changed to public domain on December 15, 2023. Primary page retains both historical CC-BY and new CC0 markers.
sources.conversion: Real L85A1, G3A3, M1911, Mosin9130 and Dragunov mesh sources retained. ZONE replaces source color finishes with dark linear blued-steel and matte-polymer materials; wood uses verified retained CC0 LonesomeDucky bat base-color/normal maps with projected UVs and walnut color factor. These are explicit ZONE adaptations, not original author colors/PBR.

sources.author: JeanPFP / LonesomeDucky
sources.conversion: Actual author low-poly geometry retained. All original materials/photos removed. LonesomeDucky's retained CC0 bat wood base color and normal maps sampled only over clean wood with new projected UVs; restrained physical steel material. Not the original author texture atlas and not an exact sawed-off replica.
sources.excluded_original_materials: Source packed TexturesCom photo atlas is retained privately for research only, absent from all runtime GLBs.
